target_stage: Delhi High Court petition under Article 227 challenging the Rent Control Tribunal's eviction order

IK-14884716:L67:span1.text: The eviction petition was filed by the Respondent No. 1 on the assertion that its tenant Canara Bank i.e., Respondent No. 2 has let out the Signature Not Verified Digitally Signed CM(M) 380/2023 Page 1 of 13 By:Rashmi Dabas Signing Date:20.10.2023 10:34:02 different portions of the property bearing No. H-61, H Block, Gobind Mansion, Connaught Circus, New Delhi ('subject property') to five (5) sub- tenants without the knowledge and authority of the landlords.

IK-14884716:L69:span2.text: The Rent Control Tribunal by its impugned order dated 20.01.2023 held that Respondent No. 2, Canara Bank has sub-let the subject property to the sub-tenants including the Petitioner herein unlawfully as no consent in writing of the landlord was obtained.

IK-14884716:L77:span3.text: Respondent No. 1, landlord had due notice of the fact that the subject property has been sub-let to the Petitioner herein by Respondent No. 2, the original tenant i.e., Canara Bank.

IK-14884716:L78:span4.text: He states that the sub-letting in the favour of Petitioner herein is in the year, 1944.

IK-14884716:L85:span5.text: It is denied that the premises has been sub-let by the respondent No.1· in favour of the respondents No. 2 to 6.

IK-14884716:L90:span6.text: the respondents No. 2 to 6 namely Shri Rajinder Dhawan. H.S. Ahuja & co., G.K. Arora & Co., United India Insurance Co. Ltd. and Canara Bank Employees Union are using different portions of the premises in suit well within the knowledge of the landlord.

IK-14884716:L99:span7.text: the respondents No.2 to 6 named above have been using different portions of the premises in suit merely as a licensees.

IK-14884716:L134:span8.text: this is neither the case of the Respondents nor any document in this regard has been brought on record that sub-tenancy dates back prior to 09.06.1952.
